data.action: 足尖点梁翻转腾挪，蝶翼羽织展开，毒针寒光，落地眨眼
data.camera: dynamic action shot, mid-air twist, haori spread, venom flash
data.description: 【黄昏的天守遗迹·鬼气弥漫】紫蝶般的身影在残垣间翻转腾挪，蝶翼羽织在身后展开如真正的蝶翅。忍足尖轻点断梁，毒针在指间寒光一闪，脸上却始终挂着那抹温柔的笑——「虫之呼吸 · 蜈蚣之腹。」轻如蝶落，毒已入髓。她落地收刃，对呆住的你眨了眨眼——「看呆了呢。要跟上哦，下一个敌人可不会等你。」
data.lighting: 橙紫渐变的黄昏天光与蝶翼羽织的紫纹
data.promptProse: Shinobu Kocho twists through the ruined keep, her toe pushing off a broken beam as her narrow blade traces the Insect Breathing strike. Butterfly-patterned haori spreads behind the black uniform and white belt while her gentle smile remains composed. The dynamic view holds fractured walls and lower beams at distinct distances. Orange-violet dusk outlines the airborne sleeves, catching a brief cold glint on the blade and leaving the ruins' inner gaps dark.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 虫之呼吸的蝶舞·「虫之呼吸 · 蜈蚣之腹 ひらり」
